method.baselinePreparation: Create a detached worktree at baselineCommit, expose the same installed candidate dependency tree used by both passes, and place benchmarkHarnessBlob at src/builder/commands/__benchmarks__/csb08-insertion.bench.ts; this adds only the measurement harness and does not replace baseline production source.
method.dependencyExecution: Both passes used one installed dependency tree from candidateLockfileBlob. The baseline and candidate lockfile blobs are both retained because current main added fake-indexeddb; that package is not imported by the benchmark harness or command path.
method.baselineCommand: $env:CSB_BENCHMARK_ROOT='<detached-baseline-worktree>'; $env:CSB_BENCHMARK_OUTPUT='workspaces/components/assets/csb-08-baseline-benchmark.json'; $env:CSB_BENCHMARK_LOG_OUTPUT='workspaces/components/assets/csb-08-baseline-benchmark.txt'; pnpm dlx node@24.19.0 node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs bench --config vitest.config.mts src/builder/commands/__benchmarks__/csb08-insertion.bench.ts --run --environment node --maxWorkers 1 --no-file-parallelism
method.candidateCommand: Remove-Item Env:CSB_BENCHMARK_ROOT -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $env:CSB_BENCHMARK_OUTPUT='workspaces/components/assets/csb-08-candidate-benchmark.json'; $env:CSB_BENCHMARK_LOG_OUTPUT='workspaces/components/assets/csb-08-candidate-benchmark.txt'; pnpm dlx node@24.19.0 node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs bench --config vitest.config.mts src/builder/commands/__benchmarks__/csb08-insertion.bench.ts --run --environment node --maxWorkers 1 --no-file-parallelism

revisions.candidateState: clean committed source tree; only generated evidence artifacts changed during execution
